novelty_search.nearest_result: Aligned joint installation preserved both tasks and obeyed the additive response law, but q_has exceeded the partner-surcharge ceiling on is/was A2/P.
novelty_search.new_question: Can either program execute its own temporal command when the other released program receives the opposite direction, or does cross-output reuse become destructive interference?

frozen_operator.own_command: The scored population's released program receives the row's registered direction.
frozen_operator.partner_command: The other released program receives the exact opposite direction on the same source resid:10 state.
frozen_operator.populations_source_and_scoring: Identical to aligned composition v1: has/had v5 and is/was v6; donor source for P and base otherwise; exact native output pair.
forbidden: donor or outcome access for gain

bars.own_route_replay: Own-only family metrics reproduce both prospective receipts within 1e-5.
bars.opposed_joint_A: Within each population, A1/A2 mean recovery >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
bars.opposed_joint_P: Within each population, P mean reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75.
bars.opposed_joint_C: Within each population, C mean normalized unrelated effect <=0.20.
bars.additive_law: Every population/family mean absolute nonlinear composition residual <=0.20 target scales.
bars.opponent_effect_sign: For A1/A2/P, at least 0.75 of partner-only effects reverse the aligned partner effect sign; this verifies the command opposition is live rather than a dead knob.

predictions.pred_a_authority_basis_capability_and_ex: All aligned-result, program, population, basis, capability, and exact-head controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_opposed_program_identity_a: Own and opposite partner alphas exactly use released coefficients with no forbidden input; own routes replay.
predictions.pred_c_opposed_has_had_program_preservat: The has/had population passes opposed joint A1/A2/P/C bars.
predictions.pred_d_opposed_is_was_program_preservati: The is/was population passes opposed joint A1/A2/P/C bars.
predictions.pred_e_additive_law_and_live_opposition: Every family passes additive residual, and A/P partner effects reverse aligned signs on at least 0.75 of rows.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: 128 unique rows use exactly four forwards/256 examples, eight inherited gains, two frozen bases, and zero fit/grid/root/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: the programs remain independently manipulable under opposing commands.
terminal.null: Authority, identity, replay, live opposition, and coverage pass but one program loses its own behavior under the opponent.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, basis, head, identity, own replay, live-opposition, or coverage fails.
